summary: Spot market buyers are actively absorbing heavy perp selling pressure (-89.88 BTC CVD) right at the Value Area High of 81,150. A clean breakout and acceptance above VAH risks triggering a leverage squeeze, while a failure to hold will re-target the POC at 80,950.
